statement: ∀ (p n : ℕ), p.Prime → 2 ≤ n → let c : ℕ := if p=2 then 4 else p; multiplicity p n < (n-1)*multiplicity p c

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 缩放对数与 Theta 值 · JA-0009 · 在二进和奇素数处统一证明首项严格占优
plain_statement.en: New route · Scaled logarithms and theta values · JA-0009 · Show strict first-term dominance at the dyadic and odd places

brief.zh: 先用 (p−1)vₚ(n)≤n−1；p=2 时 c=4 提供额外的严格性。
brief.en: Use (p−1)vₚ(n)≤n−1. The choice c=4 gives strictness at p=2.
